Messages.Author: Brum
Messages.Body:


After a block the Blocking Minion always taps, even if the action
doesn't resolve, e.g. without combat.
Unless stated otherwise, of course.
Example: on blocker's side there's Obedience, o acting's side there's
Change of Target.

Tiago

Messages.Author: cthulukitty
Messages.Body:
Asnek wrote:
> As we got here small argument about this card i want to clarify if it
> really works how we thought.
> If Baali A blocks the action and another Baali B can play Bloodstorm.
> card text indicates that it's possible as there is no said
> Only
> usable when THIS Baali succesfully blocks...
> question is if it will work this way:

I'm fairly certain that the card doesn't do that. It is odd that
Bloodstorm simply reads "a Baali" when all the similar cards I looked
for (eg. Obedience, Voice of Madness, Shattered Mirror, Mental Maze)
read "this vampire". This does to some extent seem to suggest that
your interpretation works, and one could certainly parse the sentence
that way in standard English. Unfortunately, a lot of VTES cards have
confusing and/or inconsistent text, and this is simply an example of
that.

> Azaneal blocks and embrace (Baali of course) will play blood storm and
> become tapped (per card text) and as the action is ended per card text
> Azaneal do not tap. otherwise this deck will need small reconstruction
> to increase untaps...

This is moot if the card can't be played in the manner you describe.
Even if you can, however, Azaneal taps, since that is an effect of
blocking successfully. "Tap this Baali" is simply reminder text; you
would have to tap even if the card didn't say so.

Jesse
